verdict.rationale: Rollbar's docs describe Resolve, an in-product AI agent on its root-cause-analysis page that takes a production error and produces a pull request for review. That is AI-generated analysis and a concrete fix suggestion drawn from the user's error data. The evidence is a single doc sentence, though, and covers only error-to-fix suggestions; 'intelligent error grouping' is not shown to be AI-driven. Missing for 10: broader AI insights (summaries, trends, anomaly explanations), documented depth of the root-cause analysis output, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Resolve's quality.
